item.title: AI Developer Tools Adoption Statistics 2026: The Complete Data
item.description: Nine in ten developers now use at least one AI tool at work — a number that would have seemed implausible three years ago. The JetBrains Developer Ecosystem Survey from January 2026 puts overall adoption at 90%, with 74% having moved beyond general-purpose chatbots to adopt specialized coding assistants or agents. Trust, however, has not kept pace: only 29% of developers report trusting AI tool output, a collapse from over 70% in 2023. The gap between adoption and trust is the central tension defining the developer tooling landscape in 2026.
